description: Terraform archetype (platform, terraform-provider-prefect). Groups provider and module bumps separately.

postUpgradeTasks.description: Regenerate terraform-docs module READMEs after a bump so the terraform-docs pre-commit check does not fail in CI. Guarded on .terraform-docs.yaml so repos without that hook (e.g. platform, terraform-provider-prefect which generate docs differently) no-op. Renovate runs commands directly (no shell), so shell operators like && must be wrapped in `bash -c`. The runner's RENOVATE_ALLOWED_COMMANDS must permit terraform-docs; the entrypoint installs the binary.

packageRules.description: Widen version constraints on a major bump instead of replacing them. Renovate's default (auto/replace) collapses a compound range like `>= 2.13.5, < 3` to `< 4`, silently dropping the lower bound -- a real regression for published modules where the floor is a compatibility contract. `widen` keeps the floor and extends the ceiling (`>= 2.13.5, < 4`). Major provider bumps still warrant human validation before merge.
